newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stable as swaps up slightly.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stable as swaps up slightly.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was stable against the dollar in calmer late trading on Tuesday but swap premiums edged up on offshore purchases, dealers said.
One Japanese bank dealer said the market was calmer as offshore players re-entering the longer-term swap market.
"Some are looking for good levels to sell the dollar. I think the rupiah could stage a gradual recovery when the regional markets calm down," the dealer said.
"But some offshore players are buying longer-term swaps, causing rates to increase slightly from early lows," he said.
But the dealer said some offshore players might have to boost swap rates because they were too long in the swap market.
"I don't think they can cut their heavy long positions now. They have to raise them to higher levels before they could sell. Otherwise the losses are too large," he said.
One local bank dealer said local players were seen delivering the amounts needed by those offshore because they could make good profits out of arbitrage from the money market.
He said money market rates were so low that local players could fill the offshore appetite for swaps.

Overnight money fell to six percent from 15 percent in the morning. The central bank offered bilateral overnight papers (SBIs) at six percent, one-week at seven percent, two at 8.25, one-month at 10.25, three- at 10.50, six and 12-month at 11.25 and 12.00 percent, respectively.
Spot rupiah was at 2,450.5/51.5 at 1000 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,455.0/65.0. Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,450.0/1.0 and 2,446.5/47.5, respectively.
Overnight swap was at 0.38/0.40 and tom/next at 0.5/0.6.
Southeast Asian currencies were still edgy, but traders said volatility in the markets appeared to be slowing down.
One-month swap edged up to 18.0/20.0 from 16.0/20.0, two to 33.0/40.0 from 30.0/35.0, three to 58.0/62.0 from 50.0/55.0 and six to 108/112 from 102/105 points.
Bank Indonesia raised its intervention band by one point to 2,376/2,680 but lowered the conversion band to 2,425/2,473 on Tuesday.
